result.topic_en: Euler concludes that numbers of the forms 2pp+qq and 2pp−qq are never divisible by primes of form 8m−3, deduces in Scholion 1 the quadratic character of ±2 for primes 8m−1 and 8m−3 while admitting the 8m+1 case seems unprovable by this reasoning, and in Scholion 2 announces a summary table for ±2 and ±3.
